scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,telegram-mcp -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @agentic/server" "npm run dev -w @agentic/web" "npm run dev -w @agentic/telegram-mcp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentic/shared && npm run build -w @agentic/server && npm run build -w @agentic/web && npm run build -w @agentic/telegram-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agentic/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agentic/server && npm run typecheck -w @agentic/web && npm run typecheck -w @agentic/telegram-mcp
